question: Name the metal ion used in the Veri-Green process.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zinc.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this process, also known as the** Veri-Green process,** the vegetables are **blanched in the usual fashion however 100 to 200 ppm of zinc or copper** ions are present in the blanched water.
 
• It is stated that the addition of metal ions results in vegetables that are greener than those conventionally processed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Aluminium, Gallium, Indium, and Thallium are silvery white metals.**
 
• Aluminum is a major element of numerous common igneous minerals, including feldspars and micas.
 
• Gallium, indium, and thallium are less abundant than aluminum and tend to do low attention to sulfide minerals rather than oxides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aluminum:**

 
 
• Aluminum( Al), also written aluminum, is a light argentine white essence in the periodic table's major Group 13( IIIa, or boron group).
 
• Aluminum is the most abundant metallic element(aluminum element) in the Earth's crust and the most current nonferrous essence.
 
 
 
• **Potassium:**
 
 
• Potassium is an essential mineral that is critical to many body functions, including the delivery of nerve signals, contraction of muscles, regulation of heartbeats and blood pressure, movement of nutrients into cells, and removal of cellular waste.
 
 
 
• **Sodium:**
 
 
• Sodium is a member of the alkali metal family with lithium and potassium.
 
• Being one of the two elements in our table salt __is its biggest claim to fame.
